sample_scam_messages.title: Bank Account Block Threat (Cross-Signal Demo)
sample_scam_messages.text: URGENT ALERT: Your SBI Bank Account will be BLOCKED within 30 minutes due to pending KYC verification. Click http://sbi-kyc-update-auth9.net to verify your PAN and Aadhaar immediately to prevent debit freeze.

sample_scam_messages.title: Fake Electricity Disconnection Scam
sample_scam_messages.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because previous month bill is unpaid. Please immediately call electricity officer on 98721XXXXX or pay via link.

sample_scam_messages.title: Lottery / Prize Claim Scam
sample_scam_messages.text: Congratulations! You have won a cash reward of Rs 25,00,000 in KBC Lucky Draw. Share your 6-digit OTP and bank details to claim cash deposit immediately into your account.

sample_scam_messages.title: Follow-up Extortion / Pressure SMS (Cross-Signal Demo)
sample_scam_messages.text: FINAL NOTICE: Verification payment of Rs 8000 pending. Transfer immediately to Helpline Officer Wallet to unfreeze your bank services.

sample_scam_messages.title: Genuine Bank Alert (Safe Example)
sample_scam_messages.text: Your account ending with XX4210 has been debited by Rs 1,150.00 on 10-Oct-2026 towards Electricity Board BillPay. Available Balance: Rs 24,320.00. SBI never asks for OTP or PIN.

cross_signal_scenarios.title: Connected Account Impersonation & Coerced Payment

events.title: Phishing KYC SMS Received
events.summary: Urgent SMS claiming account will freeze in 30 minutes unless verified.

events.title: ₹8,000 Transfer to Unknown Recipient
events.summary: Sudden uncharacteristic transfer to 'QuickCash Helpline Wallet'.

events.title: Follow-up SMS Demanding More Money
events.summary: Second message pressurizing user that verification is still incomplete.

cross_signal_scenarios.explanation: These events occurred within 25 minutes of each other. The urgent message was quickly followed by an unusual payment to a new recipient, followed by another demand for money. In our experience, scammers frequently use rapid pressure to trigger panicked payments.
cross_signal_scenarios.advice: 1. Do not send any further money. 2. Contact your bank's verified helpline directly. 3. Rohan Sharma has been notified to assist you.
